newsitem.title: USA: Valujet flight turns back after cockpit odor.
newsitem.headline: Valujet flight turns back after cockpit odor.

text.p: A strong electrical odor forced a ValuJet DC-9 flying from Orlando to Atlanta to make an emergency landing minutes after taking off Saturday evening, an airport spokeswoman said.

ValuJet Flight 116 took off shortly before 4:30 p.m. EDT Saturday. Minutes later it turned around and landed again, after passengers complained of a strong electrical odor, said Orlando International Airport spokeswoman Carolyn Fennell.
"There was thought to be smoke in aft or rear," Fennell said. But no fire was detected, she said.
The aircraft, carrying 37 people, landed normally and taxied on its own to a gate where passengers were evacuated. A mechanical staff was inspecting the plane Saturday night, Fennell said.
Fennell said she did not know whether passengers were rerouted to other flights.
ValuJet officials were unavailable for comment Saturday.
